name: voice-cursor
description: Voice interface to the existing Cursor Agent

commands.title: Voice Cursor: Show Last Agent Response
Voice Cursor: Set Prompt Injection Strategy

voiceCursor.serviceUrl.description: Base URL for the local Voice Cursor service

voiceCursor.autoStartService.description: Automatically start the local voice-service process if it is not reachable (recommended). Disable if you always run `npm run service` yourself.

voiceCursor.oneShotNewChat.description: If true, open a new Agent chat every turn. If false (default), open one chat on the first turn this session, then keep follow-ups in the same thread.

voiceCursor.confirmTranscript.description: Ask for confirmation before sending a transcript to the Agent (default off for faster voice turns)

voiceCursor.quietUi.description: When true, skip routine success toasts during push-to-talk (errors and the sticky listening UI still show)

voiceCursor.autoEndUtterance.description: When true, auto-send when Deepgram Flux detects end of utterance (a pause). Click Stop & Send still works. Disable for classic click-to-send push-to-talk.

voiceCursor.submitChord.description: OS key used to submit after paste. Prefer 'enter' (fastest). Use 'ctrl-enter' if your Cursor setting requires it, or 'both' as a fallback (slower).

voiceCursor.injectionStrategy.description: How to inject prompts into Cursor Agent during the Phase 1 spike

voiceCursor.submitCommandCandidates.description: Candidate command IDs to try for auto-submit after pasting a prompt
